name: Vegha Local API Testing Client
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local desktop API client and headless CLI for HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket and SOAP testing, assertions, scripting, local collections and import; no software usage quota or expiration stated.
watch_out: Runs on user-provided Windows, macOS or Linux hardware; cloud hosting and managed test execution are not included. External APIs, Azure Key Vault or AWS Secrets Manager may incur separate provider charges. Some integrations are roadmap-only.
